## artist-standalone-enrichment

Triggered by the admin app when you click **"Start Enrichment"** on the `/dashboard/artists/[id]/enrich` page.

**Flow:**
1. Webhook receives `{ artistId, artistName, links: [{platform, url, label}] }`
2. Scrapes each link URL (best-effort) + extracts `og:image` candidates for cover photo picker
3. Claude synthesizes scraped text into structured enrichment notes (facts only, no fluff)
4. POSTs callback to `ADMIN_ARTIST_ENRICHMENT_CALLBACK_URL` with `x-webhook-secret` header

**Required env vars (set in n8n .env):**
- `ADMIN_ARTIST_ENRICHMENT_CALLBACK_URL` — e.g. `https://admin.stpetemusic.live/api/webhooks/artist-standalone-enrichment-complete`
- `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` — shared secret (must match admin app)

**System prompt source of truth:** `artist-standalone-enrichment-system-prompt.md`
